RWA.note: States no rule or authority on AI harms.
AI is in a health-sector platform, which is not general administration.

facts.fact: Health minister Sabin Nsanzimana says Horizon 1000 is integrating AI-powered support into the eBuzima digital health platform for primary health facilities by 2028, with safety and effectiveness testing before any tool informs patient care.

RWA.note: No model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in Rwanda is stated.
